classes.retention: portable artifact only; do not import as active product source
ignored/local unless explicitly tiny and justified
generated context inventory; not product truth
generated root classification; not product truth
generated tool inventory/classification; not product truth
audit evidence only; do not treat samples as source truth
committed generated public artifact; source inputs remain site/* outside dist and contracts/runtime data sources

hard_rules: Generated/export/report material must not become product truth.
New tracked tmp/out/target output requires explicit policy before promotion.
Generated fixture changes must be justified by reference/schema updates and covered by validators.
non_claims: This policy does not claim production readiness.
This policy does not enable live-source, network, provider, telemetry, account, upload, or download behavior.
